notes: No wrong-group, wrongly-irregular, or wrong-slot problems found in this range.
Three headwords differ from kanji_reading_groups.pre_alignment.json; in all three the NEW assignment is the correct one:
物語/ものがたり — NEW かた.る, OLD irregular. NEW is right: 語り (がたり, 連用形 of 語る, rendaku) with 送り仮名の省略 of り.
混凝土/コンクリート — NEW irregular, OLD ト. NEW is right: 混凝土 is ateji for 'concrete'; the old pass matched the trailing katakana ト inside コンクリート, which is a coincidence, not a reading of 土.
白髪/しらが — NEW irregular, OLD しら-. NEW is right: 白髪 is a 常用漢字表付表 熟字訓; 髪 has no reading が, so no reading-by-reading account exists.
Deliberate non-findings (checked and judged correct as filed):

木綿/もめん, 土産/みやげ, お土産/おみやげ, 裸足/はだし, 何時/いつ, 何処か/どこか, 如何して/どうして, お母さん/おかあさん, 叔母/おば, お祖母さん/おばあさん, 古/いにしえ — all genuine 熟字訓/ateji or readings with no slot; irregular is correct and grouping them would teach a falsehood.
少なくとも under すく.ない (なくとも is a form of ない) and 少しも under すこ.し — correct shared-context slotting.
空く/すく under す.く, not あ.く — the kana decides and it matches.
悪口 appears twice by design: わるぐち under くち and あっこう under コウ; both are real readings of the same headword.
面白い/おもしろい under しろ.い — 面 おも + 白い しろい; the い okurigana confirms the slot over しろ / しら-.
聞き取り under き.く, 買い物 under か.う, 千切る under ち — all 連用形 spans, correct.
Rendaku/handakuten spans all verified: 洪水 ずい, 東西 ざい, 満足 ぞく, 悪口 ぐち, 出口 ぐち, 入り口 ぐち, 青白い じろ, 水着 ぎ, 半端 ぱ, 電報 ぽう.

Minor ambiguity, not reported as a problem: 水着 sits under みず rather than the word-initial slot みず-, and 何か/何も under なに rather than なに-. The spans are phonetically identical and the hyphenless slot is the defensible default (何か is 何 + particle, not a prefix compound).
